other_conditions: Must enroll in an approved course at an ICAR‑recognised Agricultural University located outside the student’s state of domicile.
Must be pursuing a master’s degree in an approved agricultural discipline.
Must maintain merit and good conduct as certified by the head of the college/university.
Must not be absent without prior permission nor participate in any agitation, strike, etc., during the scholarship period.
Must study on a full‑time basis and cannot take any job, even part‑time.
Must not accept any other scholarship during the postgraduate study.
Must not leave the course of study within one month of admission.
Must not change the initially allocated subject for which the scholarship was awarded.
benefits_summary: ₹3,000 per month scholarship for postgraduate (master’s) students; no contingency grant is paid.
